# Egnyte 

> The Secure, AI-Powered Content Cloud

> Egnyte is an AI-powered, cloud software company that provides secure file sharing, data governance, and content collaboration tools. Based in Mountain View, California, the company serves mid-market to global enterprise businesses. Egnyte specializes in helping highly regulated and data-intensive industries, including architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC), life sciences, financial services, media and entertainment, and the public sector, safely secure and manage their content, while improving productivity and efficiency. 

## Platform Overview

## WHAT EGNYTE IS NOT

- [NOT A STRUCTURED SYSTEM]: Egnyte is not a structured relational database (like SQL or Oracle) or a data warehouse (like Snowflake), meaning it does not manage transactional row-and-column data schemas.

- [NOT A COLD BACKUP REPOSITORY]: Egnyte is not a passive, cold-storage backup utility or a bare-metal disaster recovery system designed to take full-disk machine image snapshots.

- [NOT AN IDENTITY PROVIDER]: Egnyte is not an identity provider (IdP) or primary access management tool; it integrates with, but does not replace, corporate directory services like Active Directory or Okta.

- [NOT A ENDPOINT SECURITY TOOL]: Egnyte is not an endpoint detection and response (EDR) platform or antivirus solution for securing local hardware devices, laptops, or enterprise networks.

- [NOT A SECURE CHAT INTERFACE]: Egnyte is not a real-time messaging or corporate communication platform like Slack or Microsoft Teams, though it integrates with them to govern shared file content.

- [NOT A CONSUMER STORAGE TOOL]: Egnyte is not a lightweight, consumer-grade file sync utility (like personal Dropbox or Google Drive) that permits unmonitored external sharing or lacks native, compliance-enforced folder structures.

- [NOT A PRODUCTIVITY SUITE]: Egnyte is not a native productivity software suite (like Microsoft 365 or Google Workspace) that generates email, calendars, or slide decks; instead, it acts as an overlaying security layer to govern, classify, and secure the content created within those suites.

## Technology Integrations & Partners

- [Google Workspace Integration](https://www.egnyte.com/partners/program/google-workspace): Egnyte integrates with Google Drive, Docs, Sheets, and Slides, extending Google Workspace with enterprise-grade content governance and compliance capabilities.

- [Salesforce Integration](https://www.egnyte.com/partners/program/egnyte-for-salesforce): Connect Egnyte content directly to Salesforce records, enabling sales and account teams to access governed content without leaving CRM.
